candidateSchedule: Lease retained HIGH/LOW File/range source; retain no full model ArrayBuffer or OPFS duplicate. Decode one needed weight matrix or bounded row slab with full inner dimension. Bind side/block/epoch and exact dtype/scale/bias.
Patch target and each ordered context independently, concatenate logical rows into segmented immutable hidden input; preserve stream-local grid/RoPE coordinates and source IDs.
Per block generate K and V once across N_total into segmented/head-major host stores; QK RMS normalization must reduce complete5120 channels before splitting40heads; apply source-aware RoPE.

Keep immutable hidden input and separate hidden output. For each128-query row group generate full5120 Q with a cached full-inner matrix. For all40heads scan exact256-key tiles including tail; use F32 online max/numerator/denominator, never concatenate all scores.

Prefer one new batched ORT QK/scale/max/exp/AV/recurrence graph to avoid scalar Hike AV and host weight-result roundtrips. Hike remains responsible for declared norm/RoPE/pointwise boundaries. Equivalent F32 behavior must be independently verified; this is not the existing E7 graph.

Project attended rows through self O and gated residual directly into hidden output. After all self queries finish release KV; apply cross-attention and norm/FFN by128-row groups, preserving complete5120/13824 reductions. Cross/FFN row-local results may replace hidden output in place.

Swap hidden input/output only after complete block success. Execute all40 blocks. Apply final norm/modulation/head64 to all N_total in rows; slice target afterward and unpatchify to exact target latent.

For six Euler updates retain only required target latent/noise/prediction/history. Release weight leases and old side resources across HIGH-to-LOW; preserve original schedule and latent representation contract.

capacity.singleBufferPolicy: Segment hidden ArrayBuffers <=256MiB; K/V may use40 separate head stores. No entire hidden tensor clone at each owner call.
capacity.admissionFormula: memoryCurrentBeforeJob + 81920*N_total + 3GiB runtime/copy allowance + 1GiB margin <= memory.max. Reject actual request if not satisfied; do not trim source/refs.
capacity.reserveMeaning: Planning allowance for host decoded matrix caches, one ORT WASM arena, Hike arenas, native input/output copies, raw slice/transient decoding, browser overhead and old/new session overlap. This is not a measured or proven allocator upper bound.
capacity.wasmArenaPolicy: Keep each WASM32 Memory bounded independently; global hidden/KV stores remain in segmented host memory. ORT arena high-water must be measured; release sessions does not imply immediate Memory shrink.

computeEstimate.interpretation: Tiling removes allocation growth, not quadratic attention arithmetic. KV traffic assumes each K/V row read once per query tile and excludes actual copy multipliers. Full duration cannot be promised before new production operators are measured.

normalP4.limitations: Not prefix/self-attention/fullblock/head/predict/sample. Small row/output tiling and repeated input copies dominate differently from a new batched architecture. Do not multiply131s by N/2 and claim an actual or guaranteed speed.
